en.title: Beyond the Mirror, Misunderstandings Galore: In a City Where Dawn's Radio Won't Stop
en.premise: When a seemingly ordinary warped mirror is brought into a secondhand shop, a self‑styled detective and a self‑styled psychic clash in the worst possible way over its meaning. Adding to the chaos, a mysterious radio broadcast that only airs at dawn is mistaken for a divine oracle or a secret code, and the situation balloons into a conspiracy of cosmic proportions. Misinterpretations snowball, no one dares to seek the truth, and a noisy yet hollow uproar unfolds.

zh.title: 镜子背后全是误会：黎明广播永不停歇的城镇
zh.premise: 一面看似普通的扭曲镜子被送进古董店后，自称名侦探与自称灵能者的解读以最糟糕的方式冲突。与此同时，只有黎明才会播出的神秘广播被误认为“神谕”或“密码”，事态自行膨胀成宇宙级阴谋。误会像滚雪球般越滚越大，没人愿意面对真相，喧闹却空洞的大骚动由此展开。
